Figure 5:Overview of Expert-Space Exploration Reinforcement Learning (ESRL).During rollout (left), ESRL preserves anchored experts𝒮anchored\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{anchored}}in blue and explores additional experts𝒮explore\mathcal{S}_{\mathrm{explore}}in orange. The routing-noise scaleσ\sigmais adaptively controlled by the normalized router entropyℋ\mathcal{H}, with perturbation restricted to the exploratory pool. The resulting changes in expert activation alter sparse computation paths, producing different token outputs and rollout trajectories as indicated with different colors. During optimization (right), routing replay bypasses the Top-KKdecision and reuses the previously stored rollout expert path to construct𝒮train\mathcal{S}^{\mathrm{train}}, maintaining rollout–training routing consistency for policy optimization.
